payload.title: Qualify model-facing edit ergonomics while preserving exact atomic admission
payload.summary: Original CANDIDATE-08 requests comparison of model-facing edit formats without weakening source authority. Existing Engineering19 and22 receipts document oversized/wrong-owner proposals; Engineering26 exposed a separately corrected EOF patch-generation defect. Current component diagnostics and host-resolved anchors address real friction, but no matched evidence establishes that another edit format improves coding. Qualify syntax, semantic reasoning and host failures separately before proposing a controlled interface comparison.

payload.benefit: Determine whether a simpler presentation reduces source-admission repair burden without creating another validator or confusing model-authored changes with host repair.
payload.uncertainty: Alternative-format effectiveness is unmeasured. No new inference, adapter, patch splitting, byte-limit increase, automatic correction, weakened exact observation, or Aider adoption is authorized. Preserve current public and historical contracts; source admission stays authoritative.
